name: agent-design-skill
description: Design partner skill for frontend agents. Kills AI-slop: 10 tells with positive direction, five commands (detect, audit, deslop, shape, craft), grilling-first planning, measured with agent-skills-eval.

scripts.test: node --test scripts/design-parser.test.mjs scripts/detector.test.mjs scripts/concept-seed.test.mjs scripts/design-system-check.test.mjs scripts/css-scan.test.mjs
scripts.eval: set -a; [ -f ./.eval-key.go.env ] && . ./.eval-key.go.env; set +a; EVAL_API_KEY=${EVAL_API_KEY:?EVAL_API_KEY is not set: create .eval-key.go.env with the opencode account key (personal, gitignored)} npx -y agent-skills-eval --config agent-skills-eval.yaml ${OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL:+--base-url $OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL} ${OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_MODEL:+--target $OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_MODEL --judge $OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_MODEL}
